name: @kernloop/docscan
description: Kernloop doc-comment scanner — the in-process AST machinery that mines exported symbols and gates language-appropriate doc-comments (TS via the typescript compiler API; Python/Go/Rust/… via vendored tree-sitter WASM grammars). A check-providing LIBRARY consumed by faculty-gates' quality gate (spec §5.3, CLM-0104), not a faculty.
